chatbot.welcome: Assalam-o-Alaikum! Main AS-PRODUCTS ka consultant hoon. Main aapki kya madad kar sakta hoon?

options.question: Order kaise karein?
options.answer: Order karne ke liye 'Order Now' button dabayein, apni maloomat (Name, Address, Number) likhein aur 'Place Order' par click karein. Phir WhatsApp par message send kar dein. Bas!

options.question: Delivery kab milegi?
options.answer: Delivery pooray Pakistan mein 2 se 4 din mein mil jaye gi. InshaAllah humari team jald az jald aap tak parcel puhanchane ki koshish kare gi.

options.question: Kya pehle check kar sakte hain?
options.answer: Jee bilkul! AS-PRODUCTS aapko 'Open Parcel' ki saholat deta hai. Aap parcel khol kar check kar sakte hain aur tassali karne ke baad payment karein.

options.question: Quality ki kya guarantee hai?
options.answer: Hum sirf premium aur 100% original quality deliver karte hain. Quality par koi compromise nahi hota, isi liye humara kafi repeat customer base hai.

options.question: Contact kesy krein?
options.answer: Aap hum se kisi bhi waqt WhatsApp par rabta kar sakte hain (0300 2749065). Humari koshish hoti hai ke aapko jald az jald reply diya jaye.
